recipe.title: Orange and ricotta pancakes with strawberries
recipe.intro: The last sweet oranges from Spain overlap with the first British strawberries in early May. The zest goes into the batter and both fruits pile on top.
steps: Finely grate the zest of 2 oranges into a large mixing bowl. Cut the peel and white pith off all 3 oranges, slice into rounds, then into chunks.
Put the orange chunks in a second bowl with the strawberries and honey, stir gently and leave to sit so the juices run while you make the pancakes.
Add the flour, sugar and salt to the zest. In a jug, whisk the ricotta, eggs and milk until mostly smooth. Pour into the flour and whisk briefly to a thick batter. A few lumps are fine.
Heat the frying pan over a medium heat and melt a small knob of butter. Drop in heaped tablespoons of batter, 3 or 4 at a time, and spread each one slightly.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear on top and the underside is golden. Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, until risen and springy in the middle.
Keep the cooked pancakes warm under a clean tea towel while you cook the rest, adding a little butter to the pan each time. You should get about 16.
Serve the pancakes in stacks with a spoonful of yoghurt, and spoon the orange and strawberries over with all their juices.
recipe.tip: Cool any leftover pancakes, freeze them between sheets of baking paper for up to a month and reheat straight from frozen in the toaster.
